senses.gloss: f. constr. (b. h.; v. next w.) as much as, in accordance with.
units: <cite ref="Chagigah 8a:8">Ḥag. 8ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 16:10">Deut. XVI, 10</cite>). <he>מ׳ מלמד … מביא חגיגתו וכ׳ …</he> Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) ‘in accordance with’ (the free-will offering &c.), this intimates that one must procure his festal offering with secular money (not from second tithe-money).
Ib. מאי משמע דהאי מ׳ וכ׳ where is the intimation that this missath means secular? (Answ. ref. to מַס, Esth. X, 1).
